properties.displayName: UAV S9 - SATCOM Terminal Disruption (Link Loss / Sustained RTT / Session Hijack)
properties.description: SATCOM 단말/관리망 무력화 탐지: 2분 이상 레코드 없음, RTT 지속 급등 3회+, JamIndicator 지속 상승, SessionId 강제 변경. 실측 기반 임계값. MITRE: T1133, T1542. ICS: T0814, T0881
properties.query:
let rttThreshold = toscalar(
    _GetWatchlist('UAV_Threshold_List')
    | where ThresholdKey == 'MaxRttMs_SATCOM'
    | project toreal(Value));
let jamThreshold = toscalar(
    _GetWatchlist('UAV_Threshold_List')
    | where ThresholdKey == 'MaxJamIndicator'
    | project toreal(Value));
let alertWindow = 15m;
let LinkLost =
    UAVSatcomLink_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | summarize LastRecord=max(TimeGenerated) by UAVId, LinkId
    | where LastRecord < ago(2m)
    | extend TriggerReason = "SATCOM_링크_두절_2분초과"
    | extend Severity = "High";
let SustainedRtt =
    UAVSatcomLink_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | where toreal(RttMs) > rttThreshold
    | summarize HighRttCount=count(), MaxRtt=max(toreal(RttMs)),
        DurationMin=datetime_diff('minute', max(TimeGenerated), min(TimeGenerated))
        by UAVId, LinkId, SessionId
    | where HighRttCount >= 3 and DurationMin >= 2
    | extend TriggerReason = strcat("SATCOM_RTT_지속급증_", tostring(toint(MaxRtt)), "ms_", tostring(DurationMin), "분")
    | extend Severity = "High";
let SustainedJam =
    UAVSatcomLink_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | where toreal(JamIndicator) > jamThreshold
    | summarize JamCount=count(), MaxJam=max(toreal(JamIndicator))
        by UAVId, LinkId, SessionId
    | where JamCount >= 3
    | extend TriggerReason = strcat("SATCOM_재밍_지속_MaxJam_", tostring(round(MaxJam, 3)))
    | extend Severity = "High";
let SessionChange =
    UAVSatcomLink_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | order by UAVId, TimeGenerated asc
    | extend PrevSessionId = prev(SessionId, 1)
    | where SessionId != PrevSessionId and isnotnull(PrevSessionId)
    | project TimeGenerated, UAVId, LinkId, OldSession=PrevSessionId, NewSession=SessionId
    | extend TriggerReason = strcat("SATCOM_SessionId_변경_", PrevSessionId, "→", SessionId)
    | extend Severity = "High"
    | summarize FirstSeen=min(TimeGenerated) by UAVId, LinkId, TriggerReason, Severity;
union
    (LinkLost | project FirstSeen=LastRecord, UAVId, LinkId, TriggerReason, Severity),
    (SustainedRtt | project FirstSeen=now(), UAVId, LinkId, TriggerReason, Severity),
    (SustainedJam | project FirstSeen=now(), UAVId, LinkId, TriggerReason, Severity),
    (SessionChange | project FirstSeen, UAVId, LinkId, TriggerReason, Severity)
| extend IncidentType = "S10_SATCOM_무력화"
| order by Severity desc, FirstSeen asc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S9 - SATCOM Terminal Disruption (Link Loss / Sustained RTT / Session Hijack) - {{UAVId}}
